status: independent exact rational audit of the signed-rank-one interior obstruction
orientation: For order pi, M_pi is lower in permutation order and solves y_pi[k]=1-(1-mu)*sum_(l<k)y_pi[l].

general_formulae.iterated_ratio_limit: lim_(mu up to 1) lim_(n to infinity) gamma(A)/mu <= 1/2

quantifier_consequence: For every c>1/2, first choose fixed mu<1 sufficiently close to 1, then choose n sufficiently large; the displayed parallel ratio is below c.
scope_warning: This rules out global one-epoch K(A)>=c*mu*A^-1 only for c>1/2. It does not refute c=1/2, the covariance spectral conjecture, or the O((n/mu) log(1/epsilon)) complexity order.
